A tsakiyar gari akwai wani babban tafkin ajiyar ruwa na dutse, yana cika da ruwan saman damina, mutanen garin kuma suna sha daga cikinsa har ruwan sama ya dawo.

Baba Abu Khalil ne yake kula da shi, yana cika wa kowane gida tuluna biyu kowace safiya, ba ya ƙara wa wani gida a kan wani.

Lina takan zo ta ɗauki tulunan gidansu biyu tare da ƙaninta Karam. Idan ta isa gida, takan zuba daga cikinsu a tsakar gida don ya yi sanyi, ta yayyafa wa Karam sai ya yi dariya, kuma ta wanke tufafin 'yar tsanarta sau biyu a kowace rana.

Sai mahaifiyarta ta ce mata: "Lina, wannan ruwan gari ne gaba ɗaya, kuma tsakaninmu da ruwan sama akwai doguwar rani."

Sai Lina ta ce: "Tafkin babba ne, Mama, me tulu ɗaya zai rage masa?"

Ba Lina kaɗai ce take faɗin haka ba; a kowane gida akwai wanda yake faɗin irin wannan, yana zubar da irin abin da take zubarwa.

Baba Abu Khalil yakan duba tafkin kowace yamma, sannan ya wuce ba ya cewa komai.

Maƙwabciyarsu Inna Ummu Jamil tsohuwa ce da take zaune ita kaɗai. Idan ta yi alwala, takan tara ruwan alwalarta a cikin kwano, sannan ta shayar da shukar ƙamshi da ke kan tagarta da shi.

Lina takan kalle ta daga saman katanga tana mamaki, tana cewa a ranta: "Kai, tana tsananin kula da ruwa!"

Da rani ya tsananta, Baba Abu Khalil ya saukar da guga cikin tafkin, amma bai kai ruwa ba sai da ya sakar da duk igiyar.

Sai ya tara mutanen garin ya ce: "Daga yau tulu ɗaya ne ga kowane gida. Idan abin da ya rage ya ishe mu, za mu kai ga ruwan sama; idan ba haka ba, ba mu da komai sai maɓuɓɓuga mai nisa a cikin kwari."

Sai tulu ɗaya ya zama na sha, da kwaɓa fulawa, da alwala gaba ɗaya. Zafi ya tsananta, sai Karam ya ji ƙishirwa kafin la'asar, kuma babu komai da ya rage a cikin tulu.

Sai Lina ta fita zuwa tsakar gida, sai ta ga ƙasar da ta yi ta zuba ruwa a kanta kwanaki ta bushe ta tsattsage, babu wata alama da ta rage daga wannan ruwa.

Sai ta zauna a bakin ƙofa tana kuka. Inna Ummu Jamil ta gan ta daga saman katanga, sai ta kira ta ta ba ta kofin ruwa, ta ce: "Wannan shi ne abin da ya rage mini daga tulun jiya."

Sai Lina ta ce: "Ke kuma fa, Inna?" Sai ta ce: "Ni na san rani, 'yata, saboda haka ba na zuba ruwa sai inda zai amfana."

Sai Lina ta shayar da ƙaninta, sannan ta koma wurin Inna Ummu Jamil ta ce: "Ki koya mini."

Tun daga ranar ta fara rufe tulun, tana sha da ƙaramin kofi, tana tara ruwan da ya rage daga wanki tana shayar da itacen inabi da shi.

Idan Karam ya yayyafa mata ruwa, takan ce: "A'a Karam, wannan ruwan gari ne."

Kwanakin rani suka wuce da nauyi, Baba Abu Khalil yana cika tuluna kowace safiya ɗaya bayan ɗaya, har babu abin da ya rage a ƙasan tafkin sai kaɗan.

Sannan wata safiya a farkon damina sama ta yi baƙi, mutane suka ji tsawa.

Sai mutanen garin suka fita zuwa fili, ruwan sama yana sauka cikin tafkin, yara kuma suna gudu a ƙarƙashinsa.

Sai Lina ta ruga zuwa gida ta zo da wani babban kwano ta ajiye shi inda ruwan sama yake gangarowa daga rufin gida, Inna Ummu Jamil ma ta zo da kwanonta ta ajiye shi a gefensa.

﴿وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا وَلَا تُسْرِفُوا ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾

📖 Suratul A'raf, aya ta 31. Wannan labari ne na misali, bai faru da wani mutum na musamman ba.
